y-m-42-01.title: Pane chiitiko apo AB inogona kuverengwa asi BA isingagone here?
y-m-42-01.topic: Mamiriro (hukuru) ekuti matrix product itsanangurwe nekurongeka kwekuwanza
y-m-42-01.goal: Ziva kuti kana matrix product ichigona kuverengwa kunosarudzwa nehukuru, kwete mitengo yema entries, edza chirevo che 'unogona kushandurana kurongeka' ne counterexample, uye ugadzire mamiriro ehukuru apo ma products ese maviri anogoneka.
y-m-42-01.material:
Hukuru chete hwe ma matrices mana A, B, C, D hunozivikanwa, uye mitengo yema entries haizivikanwi. ('2×3' inoverengwa '2 by 3' uye zvinoreva mitsetse 2 nema columns 3.)
- A: 2×3
- B: 3×2
- C: 2×2
- D: 3×3
Minjun akati izvi. "Kana unogona kuverenga AB, unogonawo kuverenga BA nekurongeka kwakashandurwa. Nekuti mukuwanza unogona kushandurana kurongeka."
y-m-42-01.thinking.0: Tonga kana product inogoneka kubva pahukuru oga, pasina mitengo yema entries
y-m-42-01.thinking.2: Gadzira mamiriro ehukuru apo ma products ese maviri atsanangurwa
y-m-42-01.prereq.0: Zvinofungidzirwa kuti wakatodzidza padanho reyuniti ye matrix yeCommon Mathematics yehigh school (zvinoreva matrix, kuwedzera, ma scalar multiples, netsanangudzo yekuwanza). 'H2' i danho rekunetsa nerekutsigira chete rekugoverwa uku kwekugadzira uye hazvireve kuti Ministry of Education inopa zvirimo izvi kugiredhi riri rese.
y-m-42-01.prereq.1: Kuverenga nekunyora hukuru m×n hwe matrix (mitsetse m, ma columns n)
y-m-42-01.prereq.2: Mamiriro ekuti product yema matrices maviri itsanangurwe (hukama pakati pehuwandu hwema columns e matrix yekutanga nehuwandu hwemitsetse ye matrix yekupedzisira) nehukuru hweproduct
y-m-42-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza ma products ese anogona kusimbiswa kuti anogona kuverengwa kubva pahukuru oga.
y-m-42-01.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora product imwe neimwe muchimiro che 'hukuru hwa P · hukuru hwa Q' uye uenzanise nhamba mbiri dziri padyo pakati.
y-m-42-01.s.s1.hint.1: Pama products ane nhamba mbiri dzepakati dzakasiyana, maka nhamba ipi inosiyana, uye kune dzakafanana, nyorawo hukuru hwemhedzisiro.
y-m-42-01.s.s1.r.a: Iyi i sarudzo yakaitwa nekuenzanisa huwandu hwema columns e matrix yekutanga nehuwandu hwemitsetse ye matrix yekupedzisira. Tarisa kumashure kuti nhamba dzipi dzawakaenzanisa.
y-m-42-01.s.s1.r.b: Iyi inogona kuva sarudzo yakaitwa pasina kuenzanisa huwandu hwema columns e matrix yekutanga (3) nehuwandu hwemitsetse ye matrix yekupedzisira (2), uchifunga kuti peya chero ipi inowanzwa yakanaka.
y-m-42-01.s.s1.r.c: B ine ma columns 2 uye D ine mitsetse 3. Iyi inogona kuva sarudzo yakaitwa pasina kuenzanisa ma columns nemitsetse yemativi anowanzwa.
y-m-42-01.s.s1.r.d: Iyi i sarudzo yakaitwa nekuenzanisa nhamba mbiri dzepakati mu (2×3)(3×3).
y-m-42-01.s.s1.r.e: Iyi i sarudzo yakaitwa nekuenzanisa nhamba mbiri dzepakati mu (3×3)(3×2).
y-m-42-01.s.s1.r.f: Iyi inogona kuva sarudzo yakafunga kuti, sezvo AD ichishanda, DA nekurongeka kwakashandurwa inoshandawo. Enzanisa huwandu hwema columns e D nehuwandu hwemitsetse ye A.
y-m-42-01.s.s1.explain: Product PQ inotsanangurwa kana huwandu hwema columns e P hwakaenzana nehuwandu hwemitsetse ye Q chete. CA (2×2 · 2×3), AD (2×3 · 3×3), ne DB (3×3 · 3×2) i zviitiko zvakadaro, uye hukuru hwemhedzisiro i 2×3, 2×3, ne 3×2 zvichiteerana. AC, BD, ne DA hadzitsanangurwi nekuti nhamba dzadzo mbiri dzepakati dzakasiyana.
y-m-42-01.s.s2.prompt: Edza chirevo chaMinjun 'Kana unogona kuverenga AB, unogonawo kuverenga BA' nema matrices mana ari pamusoro. Unotonga sei?
y-m-42-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mumashoko kuti peya yemhando ipi inofanira kuvapo kuti chirevo che 'nguva dzose' chiputswe.
y-m-42-01.s.s2.hint.1: Pakati pema products awakawana kare, sa A ne B, tarisa rimwe nerimwe kana product ine kurongeka kwakashandurwa yakatsanangurwawo.
y-m-42-01.s.s2.o.a: Inogara ichishanda. Nekuti mukuwanza unogona kushandurana kurongeka
y-m-42-01.s.s2.r.a: Uku i kutonga kwakatora kushandurana kurongeka kwakajairika kwekuwanza nhamba kuenda kuma matrices sezvazvakaita.
y-m-42-01.s.s2.o.b: Hazvishande. AD inoshanda asi DA haishande
y-m-42-01.s.s2.r.b: Wakawana counterexample nekubatanidza product yakatsanangurwa neproduct ine kurongeka kwakashandurwa.
y-m-42-01.s.s2.o.c: Haugone kuziva kubva pahukuru oga; unofanira kuziva mitengo yema entries
y-m-42-01.s.s2.r.c: Kana product ichigona kuverengwa kunosarudzwa nehukuru, kwete mitengo yema entries. Siyanisa zvinoda mitengo nezvinokwana nehukuru.
y-m-42-01.s.s2.o.d: Pane mapeya sa A ne B apo zvose zvinoshanda, saka inoshanda
y-m-42-01.s.s2.r.d: Wakabvuma 'nguva dzose' kubva pamuenzaniso mumwe unoenderana zvakanaka. Zvinoitika sei kana ukatsvaga muenzaniso unoiputsa?
y-m-42-01.s.s2.explain: Chirevo che 'nguva dzose' chinoputswa ne counterexample imwe. AD inoshanda nekuti i (2×3)(3×3), asi DA i (3×3)(2×3), uye nhamba dzepakati 3 ne 2 dzakasiyana, saka haishande. Kana product ichigona kuverengwa kunosarudzwa nehukuru, kwete mitengo yema entries.
y-m-42-01.s.s3.prompt: Kana A i m×n matrix, nyora kuti B inofanira kuva nehukuru hwakadini kuti AB ne BA zvose zviverengwe, uye wobva wanyora kuti chii chimwe chinodiwa pa m ne n kuti equation 'AB = BA' inyorwe.
y-m-42-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ngatitii A i m×n, uye nyora zvakaparadzana kuti huwandu hwemitsetse nehuwandu hwema columns ye B zvinofanira kuenzana nei kuti AB ne BA imwe neimwe itsanangurwe.
y-m-42-01.s.s3.hint.1: Neya B yawakasarudza, nyora hukuru hwe AB ne BA uchishandisa m ne n uye uvaenzanise.
y-m-42-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Nehukuru hwe B hwawakanyora, wakanyora zvakananga uye wakatarisa kuti AB i m×m uye BA i n×n here?
y-m-42-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakasiyanisa 'ma products ese maviri anogona kuverengwa' ne 'AB ne BA zvine hukuru hwakafanana' here?
y-m-42-01.s.s3.model.0: B inofanira kuva n×m matrix. Ipapo AB i m×m uye BA i n×n, uye hukuru hunofanira kuva hwakafanana kuti unyore AB=BA, izvo zvinoda m=n, ndiko kuti, square matrix.
y-m-42-01.s.s3.model.1: Huwandu hwemitsetse ye B hunofanira kuva n uye hwema columns m kuti zvose zviverengwe. Kuti unyore AB=BA ma products maviri anofanira kuva nehukuru hwakafanana, saka m ne n zvinofanira kuenzana.
y-m-42-01.s.s3.model.2: B inofanira kuva matrix ye n mitsetse, m makoramu. Wobva wava AB ndi m×m uye BA ndi n×n, saka kunyora AB=BA tinoda m=n.

y-m-42-02.title: Kutsvaga ma matrix anopa chakawanikwa chakafanana kana nhevedzano yachinjwa
y-m-42-02.topic: Kutsvaga mamiriro umo ma matrix maviri anopa mhedzisiro yakafanana kana nhevedzano yokuwanza yachinjwa (2×2)
y-m-42-02.goal: Tsvaga ma matrix umo AB ne BA zvakaenzana nokutarisa vasarudzwa uye kuenzanisa zvinhu, uye usimbise nemienzaniso chaiyo kuti mhinduro haisi imwe chete asi ma matrix akawanda anosangana namamiriro.
y-m-42-02.material: Pane matrix ye 2×2 B = [[1, 1], [0, 1]] (mutsetse wekutanga 1, 1 / mutsetse wechipiri 0, 1). Kuma matrix akawanda A, AB ne BA zvakasiyana. Semuenzaniso, kana A = [[1, 2], [3, 4]], saka AB = [[1, 3], [3, 7]] ne BA = [[4, 6], [3, 4]]. Ikozvino tinoda kutsvaga A ine AB = BA. (Nhamba inhamba chaiyo, uye unogona kuinyora senhamba dzizere.)
y-m-42-02.thinking.2: Gadzira mienzaniso yakati wandei yakasiyana inosangana nemipimo
y-m-42-02.prereq.2: Kugadzira zvirevo nokuenzanisa zvinhu zvema matrix ane mavara
y-m-42-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza ma matrix A ose umo AB = BA kunyange kana yawanzwa na B nenhevedzano yakachinjwa. Tanga nokutsvaga aunogona kupa chikonzero chawo pasina kuverenga.
y-m-42-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kumusarudzwa wega wega, tanga wanyora kana paine chikonzero chaunogona kupa, pasina kuverenga, chokuti AB ne BA zvakaenzana.
y-m-42-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kumusarudzwa asina chikonzero chinouya mupfungwa, wanza zvishoma mutsetse wekutanga zvakananga uye uenzanise AB ne BA.
y-m-42-02.s.s1.o.a: A = B (matrix imwe chete na B)
y-m-42-02.s.s1.r.a: Wakatonga kuti chakawanikwa che B ne B chakafanana kunyange nhevedzano yachinjwa.
y-m-42-02.s.s1.r.b: Iyi ingava sarudzo yakafunga kuti chimiro chakaenzana saka nhevedzano haina basa. Wanza zvakananga uye uenzanise mhedzisiro mbiri.
y-m-42-02.s.s1.r.c: Wakatonga kuti chakawanikwa na O chinopa mhedzisiro imwe chete munhevedzano ipi neipi.
y-m-42-02.s.s1.r.d: Iyi ingava sarudzo yakafunga kuti zvakanaka kana zvinhu zviri pandiagonali chete. Tarisa kana zvakadaro kunyange nhamba mbiri dziri pandiagonali dzakasiyana.
y-m-42-02.s.s1.r.e: Wakatonga kuti matrix ine nhamba imwe chete pandiagonali chete inopa chakawanikwa chakafanana nematrix ipi neipi pasinei nenhevedzano.
y-m-42-02.s.s1.explain: B pachayo, zero matrix O, ne 5E (kuwanda kwakagadzikana kwe identity matrix) zvinopa mhedzisiro imwe chete kunyange nhevedzano yachinjwa na B. Kuna [[0,1],[1,0]], AB = [[0,1],[1,1]] ne BA = [[1,1],[1,0]], zvakasiyana. Kuna [[2,0],[0,3]] zvakare, AB = [[2,2],[0,3]] ne BA = [[2,3],[0,3]], zvakasiyana. Kuva ne 0 muzvinhu zvisina chinhu, kana kuva nechimiro chakaenzana, hakureve kuti nhevedzano inogona kuchinjwa uye mhedzisiro ichiramba yakafanana.
y-m-42-02.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga uye uise ma matrix 3 akasiyana A = [[a, b], [c, d]] ane AB = BA asiri kuwanda (kE) kwe identity matrix nenhamba imwe.
y-m-42-02.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora zvinhu (1,1) zve AB ne BA rimwe nerimwe nomuna a, b, c, d uye uzvienzanise.
y-m-42-02.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa zvinhu (1,2), (2,1), (2,2) nenzira imwe chete, uye usarudze nhamba dzinosangana nemamiriro ose awawana pamwe chete.
y-m-42-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Zvinhu (1,1) zve AB ne BA zvakaenzana.
y-m-42-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Tsvaga zvinhu (1,1) zve AB ne BA rimwe nerimwe uye uenzanise kana zvakaenzana.
y-m-42-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Zvinhu (1,2) zve AB ne BA zvakaenzana.
y-m-42-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Tsvaga zvinhu (1,2) zve AB ne BA rimwe nerimwe uye uenzanise kana zvakaenzana.
y-m-42-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Zvinhu (2,1) zve AB ne BA zvakaenzana.
y-m-42-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Tsvaga zvinhu (2,1) zve AB ne BA rimwe nerimwe uye uenzanise kana zvakaenzana.
y-m-42-02.s.s2.ok.c4: Zvinhu (2,2) zve AB ne BA zvakaenzana.
y-m-42-02.s.s2.fail.c4: Tsvaga zvinhu (2,2) zve AB ne BA rimwe nerimwe uye uenzanise kana zvakaenzana.
y-m-42-02.s.s2.ok.c5: b haisi 0, saka hairi kuwanda kwe identity matrix.
y-m-42-02.s.s2.fail.c5: Funga kuti riini ichiva kuwanda kwe identity matrix kana b iri 0. Basa iri rinoda mienzaniso inosiya nyaya dzakadaro.
y-m-42-02.s.s2.explain: AB = [[a, a+b], [c, c+d]] ne BA = [[a+c, b+d], [c, d]]. Kuenzanisa zvinhu (1,1) kunopa c = 0, uye kuenzanisa zvinhu (1,2) kunopa a = d, uye b inogona kuva kukosha kupi nokupi. Kana b ≠ 0, hairi kuwanda kwe identity matrix.
y-m-42-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Nyora mutemo waunoona wakafanana pakati pema A awakawana, uye utsanangure kuti zvinhu zvipi zve AB ne BA zvawakaenzanisa kuti uwane mutemo uwoyo.
y-m-42-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Isa ma matrix matatu awakawana padivi pedzimwe uye utsvage nzvimbo dzinogara dziine kukosha kwakafanana kana dzinogara dziri 0.
y-m-42-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Nyora kuti chinhu chiri panzvimbo iyoyo chinoverengwa sei muna AB nomuna BA, uye uchienzanise.
y-m-42-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakagadzira here imwe A itsva inosangana nemutemo wawakanyora uye ukatarisa nokuverenga AB ne BA zvakananga?
y-m-42-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora here mutemo zvakasiyana se 'zvinoonekwa mumienzaniso yakawanikwa' ne 'chikonzero chinowanikwa nokuenzanisa zvinhu zve AB ne BA'?
y-m-42-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Zvinofanana ndi c=0 ne a=d. Chinhu (1,1) che AB ndi a uye chinhu (1,1) che BA ndi a+c, saka kuti zvienzane c inofanira kuva 0, uye kuenzanisa zvinhu (1,2) kunopa a+b=b+d, saka a=d.
y-m-42-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Mumatrix ose awandakawana, c ndi 0 uye a ne d zvakaenzana. Izvi zvinoitika nokuti chinhu (1,1) che BA ndi a+c apo che AB chiri a, saka c inofanira kuva 0. Uyewo nhamba mbiri dziri pandiagonali, a ne d, dzinofanira kuenzana.

y-m-42-03.title: 'Pane A imwe chete kumativi ose, saka tinogona kuibvisa' zvakachengeteka here?
y-m-42-03.topic: Mukuwanza matrix, matrix imwe chete inogona kubviswa kumativi ose here?
y-m-42-03.goal: Tsvaga kukanganisa mumhinduro inobvisa A kumativi ose kubva ku AX = A sokunge inhamba, usimbise nomuenzaniso wawagadzira iwe pachako kuti mhinduro haisi imwe chete, uye ufungidzire kuti kubvisa kunogoneka pasi pemamiriro api.
y-m-42-03.material: A = [[1, 2], [2, 4]] uye E ndiyo identity matrix ye 2×2. Haeun akagadzirisa 'Tsvaga ma matrix X ose e 2×2 anosangana na AX = A' (muchakawanikwa, A iri kuruboshwe kwa X) nenzira iyi.
y-m-42-03.thinking.1: Gadzira mienzaniso inopikisa iwe pachako uye uitarise
y-m-42-03.prereq.1: Kuwanza matrix ne identity matrix E (EA = AE = A)
y-m-42-03.prereq.2: Chirevo che inverse matrix (B ine AB = BA = E)
y-m-42-03.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumwe mumhinduro yaHaeun usingagoni kuvimbwa.
y-m-42-03.s.s1.hint.0: Pamutsetse wega wega, nyora kuti wakawanikwa nomutemo upi kubva pamutsetse wapfuura, uye utarise kana mutemo uwoyo unogara uchishandawo kuma matrix.
y-m-42-03.s.s1.hint.1: Yedza kana zvinotaurwa nomutsetse wega wega zviri zvechokwadi munyaya dzose nokuverenga AX nema matrix mashoma aunosarudza iwe pachako.
y-m-42-03.s.s1.line.0: AX = A = AE. (E ndiyo identity matrix)
y-m-42-03.s.s1.line.1: Kana ukabvisa A iri kumberi kwemativi ose sokunge inhamba, X = E.
y-m-42-03.s.s1.line.2: Kuisa X = E muna AX = A kunopa AE = A, saka inoshanda.
y-m-42-03.s.s1.line.3: Saka X = E ndiyo mhinduro imwe chete ya AX = A.
y-m-42-03.s.s1.explain: Pamutsetse 2 akabvisa A kumativi ose sokunge inhamba, asi kuma matrix hakuna chivimbiso chokuti unogona kubvisa matrix imwe chete nokuti zvakawanikwa zvakaenzana. 'Mhinduro imwe chete, E' pamutsetse 4 mhedziso yakanganisa yakabva pazvo. Kuisa pamutsetse 3 kwakarurama. Asi, kunoratidza chete kuti X = E mhinduro uye hakuratidzi kuti hapana mamwe. Mutsetse 1 wakarurama zvakare.
y-m-42-03.s.s2.prompt: Ngatiti X = [[p, q], [r, s]], uye utsvage uye uise X 2 dzakasiyana dzine AX = A uye X ≠ E.
y-m-42-03.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora zvinhu zvina zve AX nomuna p, q, r, s uye uzvienzanise nezvinhu zvinoenderana zve A.
y-m-42-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa hukama hupi hunomuka pakati pa p na r nepakati pa q na s, uye usarudze peya imwe yakasiyana na E.
y-m-42-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Chinhu (1,1) che AX chakaenzana nechinhu (1,1) che A, chiri 1.
y-m-42-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Tsvaga chinhu (1,1) che AX uye utarise kana chakaenzana na 1.
y-m-42-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Chinhu (1,2) che AX chakaenzana nechinhu (1,2) che A, chiri 2.
y-m-42-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Tsvaga chinhu (1,2) che AX uye utarise kana chakaenzana na 2.

y-m-42-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Tsvaga chinhu (2,1) che AX uye utarise kana chakaenzana na 2.

y-m-42-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Tsvaga chinhu (2,2) che AX uye utarise kana chakaenzana na 4.
y-m-42-03.s.s2.fail.c5: X iyi yakafanana na E. Unofanira kutsvaga mhinduro isiri E.
y-m-42-03.s.s2.explain: AX = [[p+2r, q+2s], [2p+4r, 2q+4s]]. Kana chete p + 2r = 1 ne q + 2s = 2 zvikashanda, zvirevo zviviri zvimwe zvinoshanda pachazvo. Saka kana ukasarudza p ne q zvakasununguka uye ukatora r = (1−p)/2 ne s = (2−q)/2, pane mhinduro dzisina mugumo. Mienzaniso: X = [[3,0],[−1,1]], [[1,2],[0,0]].
y-m-42-03.s.s3.prompt: Tsanangurira Haeun 'sei usingafaniri kubvisa' uchishandisa mienzaniso yawakawana pamusoro, uye unyore mamiriro 1 umo unogona kubvisa A kumativi ose uye utaure X = E.
y-m-42-03.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza X imwe yawakawana pamusoro uye unyore mumutsara mumwe kuti AX yakaenzana nei kana waiverenga.
y-m-42-03.s.s3.hint.1: Rangarira kuti sei kubvisa kunoshanda kana A iri nhamba, uye ufunge kuti chii chinoita basa iroro mumatrix.
y-m-42-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakadzorera here chaizvo X yawakapa muna AX uye ukatarisa kuti A inobuda?
y-m-42-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora here mamiriro kwete se 'A ipi neipi inogona kubviswa' asi se 'kana A ine hunhu hwakati', uye ukapa chikonzero?
y-m-42-03.s.s3.model.0: Imwe mhinduro ya AX = A ndi X = [[3, 0], [−1, 1]]. Kana ukaiwanza, A inobuda, saka kana ukabvisa A ukanyora X = E chete, unorasikirwa nemimwe mhinduro. Kana A ine inverse matrix, unogona kuwanza inverse matrix pamberi pemativi ose uye unyore X = E.
y-m-42-03.s.s3.model.1: X = [[1, 2], [0, 0]] inosangana zvakare na AX = A, saka mhinduro haisi imwe chete. Ma matrix haagoni kubviswa senhamba, uye chete kana A ine inverse matrix ndipo paunogona kuiwanza kumativi ose uye kuidzikisa.

y-m-42-04.material:
Zvokureva: Matrix ye 2×2 [[a, b], [c, d]] ine inverse matrix chete kana ad − bc ≠ 0, uye wobva wava inverse matrix (1 / (ad − bc)) · [[d, −b], [−c, a]].

y-m-42-04.s.s1.r.c: Wakatanga wanyora ad − bc nomuna k uye wakawana ruzivo runodikanwa kubva pamamiriro okuti kukosha uku kuve 0.
y-m-42-04.s.s1.o.d: Kana k inhamba yakazara, kana chikamu kana dhesimali
y-m-42-04.s.s1.r.d: Iyi ingava sarudzo yakafunga kuti mhando yenhamba inosarudza kutonga. Tarisa kana kukosha kwa ad − bc kunochinja zvichienderana nemhando yenhamba.

Vaka nzira a 가→나, nzira b 나→다, uye nzira c 가→다 (hapana dzimwe nzira), kuti huwandu hwenzira dzekubva ku 가 kuenda ku 다 dzichipfuura nenzira 1 kana 2 huve 7 chaizvo. Zvakare, huwandu hwenzira dzinopfuura nenzira 2 hunofanira kuva hukuru kupfuura huwandu hwenzira dzinoenda zvakananga nenzira 1. Tora zvirongwa umo huwandu hwenzira 가→나 ne 나→다 hwakatsiviwa seplan imwe chete, uye utsvage uye uise zvirongwa 3 zvakasiyana.

y-m-42-09.s.s3.explain: Nzira dzekuenda 가→나→다 dzi a×b, uye nzira dzakananga dzi c, saka c + ab = 7. Nyaya dzinogutsawo ab > c ndi ab = 4 (c = 3), ab = 5 (c = 2), ab = 6 (c = 1). Mienzaniso: (2,2,3), (1,4,3), (1,5,2), (1,6,1), (2,3,1).

y-m-42-10.title: Kana kurongeka kwekuverenga ABC kuchinja, basa rinochinja zvakadii?
y-m-42-10.topic: Kuenzanisa huwandu hwekuwedzera nekurongeka kwekuwedzera mu product ye matrices matatu
y-m-42-10.goal: Tsimbisa nenhamba kuti kunyangwe mhedzisiro yakafanana nechikonzero che associative law, huwandu hwekuwedzera hunogona kusiyana zvikuru zvichienderana nema saizi, uye utsanangure chiyero nekuvaka ma saizi apo kurongeka kwakati kuri nani.
y-m-42-10.material: Kuwedzera matrix kunogutsa associative law (AB)C = A(BC). Product PQ (matrix ye m×p) ye P ye saizi m×n ne Q ye saizi n×p inowana ma entries ayo m·p nekuwedzera n imwe neimwe, saka huwandu hwekuwedzera ndi m·n·p (kuwedzera hakuverengwi). A ndi 2×50, B ndi 50×2, uye C ndi 2×50. Jun akati, 'Associative law inoshanda, saka mhedzisiro yakafanana uye huwandu hwekuverenga huchavawo hwakafanana.'
y-m-42-10.thinking.0: Siyanisa kuti 'zvakafanana' zvinoreva chii (mhedzisiro kana huwandu hwekuverenga)
y-m-42-10.thinking.2: Gadzira iwe pachako mamiriro akanaka uye utsanangure chiyero
